comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible site key used for admin (backend) forms.
modal: The public site key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used to render reCAPTCHA on admin (backend) forms. Stored encrypted.

comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible secret key used to validate admin (backend) forms.
modal: The secret key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used server-side to validate responses on admin (backend) forms. Stored encrypted.

comment: Where the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge appears on admin forms.
modal: Sets the on-screen position of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge for admin (backend) forms.

comment: The visual theme of the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge on admin forms.
modal: Selects the visual theme of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge shown on admin (backend) forms.

comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible site key used for storefront forms.
modal: The public site key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used to render reCAPTCHA on storefront forms. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: The Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible secret key used to validate storefront forms.
modal: The secret key from your Google reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible registration, used server-side to validate responses on storefront forms. Stored encrypted. Can be set per website.

comment: Where the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge appears on storefront forms.
modal: Sets the on-screen position of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge for storefront forms. Can be set per website.

comment: The visual theme of the reCAPTCHA v3 Invisible badge on storefront forms.
modal: Selects the visual theme of the invisible reCAPTCHA badge shown on storefront forms. Can be set per website.
